title: Ocean safety officers arbitration award payments
summary: Ocean safety officers will receive the first of four arbitration award payments on their October 15th paycheck. A report in August said they had received an arbitration award for a four-year contract. In April, the fire chief said the lifeguards' arbitrator would have 30 days to decide after lawyers filed final briefs.
